Reason for Mistake: The Planner instructed using the commercial reissue (5th Anniversary/remastered) date from Discogs as the canonical release date, rather than the original mixtape release date. This misinterprets the task (which asks when the performer released Best Day Ever) and could lead to the wrong answer (e.g., a 2016 reissue date) instead of the correct original release date of March 11, 2011.
